race.comment: DECLICHY BOULEVARD (8) made up for her unlucky Epsom run, when she rounded them up with ease on the limit weight to take out the Five Diamonds Prelude at Randwick over 1500m. Jumps in weight today and will have no trouble running out a strong 1800m. Go close. PLYMOUTH (9) eye catching run in the Epsom, then backed it up with a closing fourth over 1800m at Randwick in the G2 Craven Plate. This sets up nicely and has the profile to win. LINEBACKER (1) given every chance in the run with the 59.5kg for a courageous second in the Five Diamonds Prelude at Randwick.  The 2.5kg weight swing keeps him in contention and Lloyd sticks. EVAPORATE (3) sat on the fast tempo and got pushed wide on the turn with a battling seventh in the Five Diamonds Prelude. Looking to recapture the good form he showed earlier in the prep when third to Cosmic Crusader. VERONA ROSE (7) strips fitter after returning slick figures in the G2 Invitation over 1400m. Trip suits.
